pages.text: “Elegant blossoms with a gentle fragrance, carrying hidden restorative power.”$(br2)Lilac Tea is a delicately spiced tea made from dried lilac petals. The tea is clear, with a mild sweetness that lingers. Drinking it provides slow health regeneration over a short period, helping travelers recover from fatigue.

$(br2)$(br)Lilac Tea is simple to prepare—$(br)just blend dried lilac petals with sugar to create this warm and soothing tea.$(br)It is best enjoyed as a short break during travels, offering momentary recovery.

Upon drinking Lilac Tea, travelers gain a temporary health regeneration effect, allowing their vitality to slowly recover.$(br)This gentle and practical tea is useful for replenishing energy between battles or during long journeys.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
